home.pathsSubtitle: Choisissez l'itinéraire correspondant à votre situation ; chaque page présente le processus, les documents nécessaires et le délai estimé.
home.path1Text: Un proche est décédé en Turquie et vous souhaitez le rapatrier dans son pays.
home.path2Text: Un proche est décédé à l'étranger et vous souhaitez le ramener en Turquie pour y être inhumé.
home.path3Text: Le défunt est transféré d'un pays à un autre via Istanbul.
home.urgentText: Prenez un moment. Voici les trois premières choses à faire :
home.urgent1: Si le décès a eu lieu à l'hôpital, demandez l'établissement du certificat de décès ; s'il a eu lieu à domicile, appelez le 112.
home.urgent2: Gardez à portée de main la carte d'identité ou le passeport du défunt.
home.urgent3: Appelez-nous ; nous vous guiderons ensuite étape par étape.
home.processSubtitle: Sept étapes. À chacune d'elles, nous vous indiquons ce dont nous avons besoin et le délai habituel.
home.support1Text: Certificat de décès, extrait plurilingue du certificat de décès (Formule C), permis de transport funéraire, autorisation consulaire.
home.support2Text: Cercueil scellé (doublé de zinc) adapté au transport aérien et certificat de soins funéraires.
home.support3Text: Réservation du fret et lettre de transport aérien par l'intermédiaire d'agents agréés IATA.
home.support4Text: Transfert interurbain dans un véhicule réfrigéré et coordination de l'inhumation.
home.countriesSubtitle: Chaque pays dispose d'une page présentant le processus, les documents et les points à connaître. Pour un pays non répertorié, appelez-nous ; nous vous confirmerons les possibilités dès le premier appel.
home.why1Text: Nous traitons avec l'hôpital, le parquet, l'état civil, le consulat, la compagnie aérienne et les douanes ; vous échangez avec une seule personne.
home.why2Text: À chaque étape, nous vous indiquons à l'avance ce qui va se passer, ce dont nous avons besoin et le délai estimé. Le devis écrit est gratuit.
home.why3Text: Le défunt est pris en charge dans un véhicule réfrigéré et la chaîne du froid est maintenue jusqu'au départ.
home.why4Title: Expérience avec les familles vivant à l'étranger
home.why4Text: Nous organisons les services funéraires pour les touristes, les voyageurs médicaux et les ressortissants étrangers vivant en Turquie ; nous correspondons en anglais et en russe.
home.partnersTitle: Votre partenaire à Istanbul pour les assureurs, sociétés d'assistance et entreprises de pompes funèbres
home.partnersText: Nous travaillons avec les hôpitaux, les consulats, les assureurs et les sociétés d'assistance. Nous disposons d'une ligne dédiée aux entreprises pour la prise en charge à l'aéroport, les transferts nationaux, les documents et la coordination de l'inhumation.
home.contactText: Notre ligne téléphonique et WhatsApp est ouverte jour et nuit. Si vous remplissez le formulaire, nous vous rappellerons dès que possible.
home.reviewsTitle: Ce que disent les familles et nos partenaires

steps.title: Premier appel et informations
steps.text: Lors de votre appel, nous vous demandons où le décès a eu lieu, la nationalité du défunt et où il doit être transféré. Au cours du même appel, nous vous expliquons le processus et le délai estimé.
steps.need: Lieu du décès, informations figurant sur la pièce d'identité ou le passeport du défunt, numéro de téléphone du proche à contacter

steps.title: Certificat de décès et démarches officielles
steps.text: Le certificat de décès est obtenu auprès de l'hôpital ou du médecin municipal. Si le décès fait l'objet d'une procédure judiciaire, nous suivons la procédure du parquet et, si nécessaire, l'autopsie.
steps.need: Carte d'identité ou passeport du défunt
steps.time: Généralement 1 jour ; plus long en cas de procédure judiciaire

steps.title: Prise en charge du défunt et chaîne du froid
steps.text: Le défunt est pris en charge sur le lieu du décès dans notre véhicule réfrigéré puis conduit à la morgue pour être préparé au transfert.
steps.need: Proof of kinship or a power of attorney authorising release
steps.time: Le jour même, dès que le certificat est prêt

steps.title: Préparation : toilette, soins funéraires et cercueil
steps.text: La toilette et la mise en linceul sont effectuées selon la foi et la confession du défunt. Les soins funéraires sont réalisés pour le transfert international et un cercueil scellé adapté au transport aérien est préparé.
steps.need: Brèves informations sur les souhaits religieux de la famille

steps.title: Documents consulaires et de transfert
steps.text: L'extrait plurilingue du certificat de décès (Formule C), le permis de transport funéraire, le certificat de soins funéraires et l'autorisation consulaire du pays de destination sont obtenus.
steps.need: Procuration si nécessaire ; coordonnées de la personne qui recevra le défunt dans le pays de destination
steps.time: Généralement 1 à 3 jours ouvrables ; selon le consulat

steps.title: Réservation aérienne et douanes
steps.text: La réservation du fret est effectuée par l'intermédiaire d'un agent agréé IATA, la lettre de transport aérien est établie et le dédouanement est effectué. Si un proche accompagnant a besoin d'un billet, nous pouvons vous aider.
steps.need: Aéroport de destination et coordonnées de l'entreprise de pompes funèbres ou de la personne qui recevra le défunt
steps.time: 1 à 2 jours, selon les disponibilités des vols

steps.title: Remise et coordination de l'inhumation
steps.text: À l'aéroport de destination, le défunt est remis à la personne ou à l'entreprise de pompes funèbres désignée par la famille. Pour les arrivées en Turquie, nous coordonnons le lieu d'inhumation et les démarches municipales.

services.title: Our Services
services.description: International and domestic funeral transfer, documents and consular procedures, embalming and coffin preparation, burial coordination.
services.intro: Our core service is international funeral repatriation. We also provide the document, preparation and coordination services that go with it, from a single point of contact.
other: Ritual washing, shrouding and funeral ceremony arranged according to faith and denomination
Arranging a burial plot, and transfer and reburial elsewhere
Airport transfers and help with accommodation for the family
Flight tickets for an accompanying relative
Translation of documents, notary and apostille follow-up

outbound.title: Funeral Repatriation from Turkey Abroad
outbound.description: The documents, process and estimated time for bringing home a relative who has died in Turkey. Documents, embalming, coffin and air cargo coordinated from a single point of contact.
outbound.intro: If a relative who was in Turkey as a tourist, medical traveller, worker or resident has died, we bring them home. We handle every official and logistical step from the place of death to the destination airport and keep you informed throughout.
expect: Wherever the death occurred (hospital, hotel, home), we collect the deceased in a refrigerated vehicle.
We handle the death certificate, the multilingual death certificate extract (Formule C), the burial transit permit and the consular approval.
Embalming is performed and a sealed coffin is prepared in line with international air transport rules.
The airline booking, air waybill and customs clearance are completed.
We share the details the family or the local funeral director will need to receive the deceased at the destination airport.
need: The deceased's passport (or ID card and residence permit)
Name and phone number of the relative to contact in Turkey and in the destination country
Details of the person or funeral director who will receive the deceased in the destination country
Insurance policy or funeral fund membership details, if applicable
outbound.time: Usually 2-4 days if the documents are complete. A judicial procedure, an autopsy, consular working days and flight availability can extend this.
included: Prise en charge du défunt et chaîne du froid
Washing and shrouding (if requested), embalming and the embalming certificate
Death certificate, Formule C and burial transit permit
notIncluded: Air cargo charge (varies by country and weight; shown as a separate line in the quote)
Funeral director services and burial in the destination country
Flight ticket for an accompanying relative (we can arrange this if requested)
outbound.costText: The price depends on the destination country, the air cargo charge, consular fees, the type of coffin and the distance from the place of death to Istanbul. We go through these items with you in the first call and provide a free written quote.

inbound.title: Funeral Repatriation from Abroad to Turkey
inbound.description: Bringing a relative who has died abroad to Turkey: consular procedures, airport collection, domestic transfer and burial coordination.
inbound.intro: If you want to bring a relative who has died abroad to Turkey, we coordinate both ends: we correspond with the funeral director or the Turkish consulate in the country of death, receive the deceased in Istanbul, transfer them to the city of burial and handle the municipal procedures.
expect: We contact the funeral director, funeral fund or insurer in the country of death.
We follow up the Turkish consulate's transfer documents and the paperwork required for entry into Turkey.
We receive the deceased at Istanbul Airport and complete customs clearance.
We transfer the deceased to the city of burial in a refrigerated vehicle and coordinate the municipal cemetery procedures.
If the family wishes, we help arrange the funeral prayer and the burial.
need: The deceased's Turkish ID card or passport, and the death certificate issued in the country of death
Contact details of the funeral director, insurer or funeral fund in the country of death (if any)
City of burial and preferred cemetery
Details of the relative who will receive the deceased in Turkey
inbound.time: Once the procedures in the country of death are complete, collection, transfer and burial in Turkey usually take 1-2 days. The time needed abroad varies by country.
inbound.fundText: Families living in Europe are often members of a funeral fund or covered by insurance. In that case the fund's contracted funeral director carries out the transfer as far as Turkey; we take over from the airport with collection, domestic transfer and burial. We check the cover together.

transit.title: Transit Funeral Repatriation
transit.description: Transfer of the deceased between countries via Istanbul: cargo transhipment, customs and document handling.
transit.intro: When the deceased needs to be transferred from one country to another via Istanbul, we handle customs and cargo during the transhipment. This service is mostly requested by funeral directors, insurers and assistance companies abroad.
expect: We share the documents and flight plan with the funeral director in the country of departure.
We follow up customs and cargo handling during the transhipment in Istanbul.
If there is a wait between flights, the cold chain is maintained.
We pass the air waybill and flight details to the funeral director in the destination country.
need: Death certificate, embalming certificate and mortuary passport (laissez-passer) issued in the country of departure
Consular documents meeting the entry requirements of the destination country
Contact details of the funeral directors at departure and destination
transit.time: Depends on the flight connection; transhipment formalities are usually completed within the same day.

domestic.title: Domestic and Intercity Funeral Transfer
domestic.description: Intercity funeral transfer within Turkey: refrigerated vehicle, municipal permits and burial coordination.
domestic.intro: When a transfer to another city within Turkey is needed, we carry the deceased in our refrigerated vehicle and handle the municipal transfer permits and burial procedures. Taking a deceased arriving from abroad from the airport to the city of burial is also part of this service.
expect: The death certificate and the municipal transfer permit are obtained.
The deceased is collected in a refrigerated vehicle and taken to the destination city.
Cemetery and burial procedures in the destination city are coordinated with the municipality.
need: City of burial and cemetery details
A relative to contact in the destination city
domestic.time: If the documents are ready, we usually set off the same day; delivery within 1 day depending on distance.
domestic.municipalNote: Municipalities in Turkey offer free funeral services domestically. What we add is speed, document handling, foreign-language support and the coordination of everything connected with an international transfer from a single point of contact.

documents.title: Documents and Consular Procedures
documents.description: Documents required for funeral repatriation to and from Turkey: death certificate, Formule C, burial transit permit, embalming certificate, consular approval, air waybill.
documents.intro: Documents are the most time-consuming part of international funeral repatriation. The lists below give the general framework; additional documents may be required depending on the destination country. In the first call we draw up the list that applies to your case.
outbound: Death certificate (issued by the hospital or the municipal physician; can be verified via e-Devlet)
Multilingual death certificate extract (Formule C), obtained from the civil registry office
Burial transit permit, issued by the municipality
Transfer approval from the destination country's consulate (varies by country)
Air waybill (AWB), issued by the airline's cargo department
Burial permit from the prosecutor's office in judicial cases
documents.inboundTitle: For a deceased arriving in Turkey
inbound: Death certificate issued in the country of death, with translation
Transfer document from the Turkish consulate
Embalming certificate and sealed coffin certificate
Municipal permit for burial in Turkey
documents.consulateText: Turkey is a party to the 1973 Strasbourg Agreement on the transfer of corpses. For countries that are party to the agreement, the mortuary passport (laissez-passer) is the governing document; for other countries, the rules of the relevant consulate apply. We handle the consular appointment, fees and translations.
restrictions: Where death was caused by certain infectious diseases such as cholera, plague, smallpox, anthrax, leprosy or glanders, transfer is not permitted for one year under Turkish regulations.
Cremation is not available in Turkey.
If a power of attorney is needed, we arrange the notary appointment; relatives abroad can also grant one at a Turkish consulate.

process.title: The Process, Step by Step
process.description: The seven steps of funeral repatriation; the information and documents we need from you at each step, and the estimated time.
process.intro: The seven steps below are the general course of an international funeral repatriation. For each step you can see which information and documents are needed and how long it usually takes.

guide.title: Someone Died in Turkey: What to Do Now
guide.description: The first steps if a relative has died in Turkey: death certificate, ID, who to call, what to look out for.
guide.intro: This guide is for families who have to make decisions at a time of grief. It is kept short and plain. You can call us at any stage.

sections.title: If the death occurred in hospital
items: The hospital issues the death certificate; ask for a copy.
Storage time in the hospital mortuary is limited; call us for the transfer and we will collect the deceased in a refrigerated vehicle.
Keep the deceased's ID card or passport and any insurance details to hand.

sections.title: If the death occurred at home, in a hotel or elsewhere
items: Call 112; a doctor will attend and confirm the death. If there are no suspicious circumstances, the municipal physician issues the death certificate.
If the case is judicial, the prosecutor's procedure begins; an autopsy may be carried out and the process takes longer. We are with you at this stage too.
An official document is required to move the deceased; the deceased cannot be collected until it has been issued.

sections.title: If the deceased was a foreign national
items: The consulate of their country must be informed; we can make this call for you if you wish.
If there is travel insurance, health insurance or an assistance company, find the policy; the cost of repatriation is often covered.
If you want to bring the deceased home, the steps on the 'From Turkey abroad' page apply.

sections.title: If your relative died abroad
items: Call the Turkish consulate in that country, or call us; we can handle the correspondence with the consulate.
If there is a funeral fund membership or insurance, the fund's contracted funeral director carries out the transfer as far as Turkey.
For collection in Turkey, transfer to the city and burial, see the 'From abroad to Turkey' page.

dont: Do not move the deceased without an official document.
Do not separate the ID card or passport from the deceased; it is needed for the procedures.
Do not work with anyone who gives a verbal price but will not provide a written quote.
guide.cta: If you are not sure what to do, call us; we will answer your questions and, if needed, set off.

coffins.intro: For international air transport the deceased must be embalmed and carried in a sealed (zinc-lined) coffin. The coffin is chosen according to the family's wishes and the rules of the destination country; we explain the suitable, dignified options without any emphasis on price.

items.title: Sealed transfer coffin

items.title: Embalming

items.title: Ritual washing and shrouding

items.title: Cold chain

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about the cost and duration of funeral repatriation, required documents, insurance and funeral funds, power of attorney and consulates.

items.q: How long does repatriation from Turkey take?
items.a: Usually 2-4 days if the documents are complete. A judicial procedure, an autopsy, the consulate's working days and flight availability can extend this. In the first call we give you an estimate for your own situation.

Costs are usually covered by the family, an insurer or the funeral fund the deceased belonged to. If there is travel insurance, health insurance or an assistance policy, repatriation is often covered. We check the cover together.

The destination country, the air cargo charge, consular fees, the type of coffin and the distance from the place of death to Istanbul determine the price. The initial consultation and the written quote are free of charge; each item is shown separately in the quote.

The core documents are the death certificate, the multilingual death certificate extract (Formule C), the burial transit permit, the embalming certificate and the approval of the destination country's consulate. Additional documents may be required depending on the country. The full list is on the Documents and Consulate page.

items.q: Who handles the procedures if my family cannot be there?
items.a: With a power of attorney we can carry out the procedures on your behalf. Relatives abroad can also grant a power of attorney at a Turkish consulate. We keep you regularly informed about the handover and the documents.

items.q: How is the deceased carried on the aircraft?
items.a: The embalmed deceased is carried in a sealed (zinc-lined) coffin inside an air cargo crate, in the aircraft's cargo hold. The booking is made through an IATA-accredited agent.

items.q: Can a relative travel on the same flight?
items.a: In most cases, yes; a relative can travel as a passenger on the same flight. We help with the ticket. Some airlines offer a reduced fare for accompanying relatives; we confirm the current conditions with the airline.
No. Cremation is not available in Turkey. For families who wish to have a cremation, the deceased is repatriated to their home country.

items.q: Do you provide services for a non-Muslim relative?
items.a: Yes. Preparation is carried out according to their faith and the transfer proceeds in the same way. For a religious ceremony, we can help the family get in touch with the relevant community if they wish.

items.q: Can I reach you at night or at the weekend?
items.a: Yes. Our phone and WhatsApp line is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

costGuide.title: Funeral Repatriation Cost Guide
costGuide.description: The items that determine the price of funeral repatriation to and from abroad, estimated ranges, what is included and who pays.
costGuide.intro: There is no single price for funeral repatriation; the total depends on the destination country, the airline cargo charge, consular fees and the type of coffin. This page is intended to help you understand what you will be paying for before you request a quote. The first call and the written quote are free of charge.

items.title: Airline cargo charge
items.text: Set by the airline according to the destination country, the flight route and the total weight including the coffin. It is the largest and most variable item in the total cost and is shown separately in the quote.

items.title: Embalming and preparation
items.text: The embalming required for international transport, ritual washing and shrouding, and the embalming certificate.

items.title: Sealed coffin
items.text: A zinc-lined, soldered international transport coffin and the air cargo crate. The type of coffin depends on the family's wishes and the rules of the destination country.

items.title: Official documents and consulate
items.text: The multilingual death certificate extract (Formule C), the burial transit permit, translation, notary and consular fees. Fee amounts vary by country.

items.title: Domestic transfer
items.text: Transfer in a refrigerated vehicle from the place of death to Istanbul, or from the airport to the city of burial; calculated by distance.

items.title: Services in the destination country
items.text: Collection at the airport, the local funeral director, cemetery and burial fees; these are priced by the funeral director in the destination country and are not included in our quote.

costGuide.rangesNote: The ranges below are only intended to give an idea; a written quote is provided for every case. Airline charges and fees can change.

ranges.route: From Turkey to Europe (Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Austria, the United Kingdom)
From Turkey to Russia, the Caucasus and Central Asia
From Turkey to the Middle East and North Africa
From abroad to Turkey (airport collection, domestic transfer, burial coordination)

whoPays: If there is travel insurance, health insurance or an assistance policy, the cost of repatriation is usually covered; we correspond directly with the insurer.
Families living in Europe are usually members of a funeral fund; the fund carries out the transfer as far as Turkey through its contracted funeral director.
If there is no insurance or fund, the costs are met by the family. Payment is taken after the written quote has been approved, and is documented.
There is no general arrangement for free state repatriation of citizens who die abroad; consulates give guidance but do not cover the cost.
included: Collection of the deceased and the cold chain
Ritual washing, shrouding, embalming and the embalming certificate
Sealed transport coffin and air cargo crate
Follow-up of the death certificate, Formule C and burial transit permit
Airline booking, air waybill and customs
Delivery to the airport and sharing of the handover details
costGuide.cta: Call or fill in the form for a free written quote; we send an itemised breakdown within the same day.

nonMuslim.title: Funeral Services for Non-Muslims
nonMuslim.description: Preparation in keeping with the faith, ceremony coordination and repatriation for Christians, Jews and people of other faiths who die in Turkey.
nonMuslim.intro: We serve people of every faith who die in Turkey. Preparation and repatriation are carried out according to the family's faith and wishes; we help make contact with the relevant community, church or synagogue for the religious ceremony.

sections.title: For Christian families
items: The deceased is prepared and dressed according to the family's wishes; embalming is required for international transport.
We help make contact with churches and congregations in Istanbul for the service and prayers.
For repatriation, the coffin is chosen according to the family's wishes and the rules of the destination country.

sections.title: For Jewish families
items: Preparation is carried out in coordination with the community (chevra kadisha) designated by the family.
Document procedures are followed up as a priority so that the transfer can take place promptly.
We help make contact with the community in Istanbul.

sections.title: Other faiths and families without a religion
items: The family's wishes come first; a religious ceremony is not required.
Cremation is not possible in Turkey; for families who wish for cremation, the deceased is repatriated to their home country and we coordinate with the funeral director there.

notes: There are no cremation facilities in Turkey.
If burial in Turkey is wanted, there are non-Muslim cemeteries in Istanbul; a grave plot is arranged with the relevant community and the municipality.
Consulates usually keep a list of funeral directors for their own nationals; the process is carried out in line with the consulate.

tracking.title: Suivi du dossier

tracking.intro: Saisissez le code de suivi qui vous a été communiqué pour connaître l'étape à laquelle se trouve votre dossier. Si vous n'avez pas de code ou si le statut n'est plus à jour, appelez-nous.

germany.name: Allemagne
germany.title: Allemagne - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
germany.description: Rapatriement funéraire depuis Germany vers Turkey et depuis Turkey vers Germany: caisse funéraire, consulat, aéroport collection, inhumation coordination.
germany.intro: Germany - Turkey est l'un des le busiest funeral repatriation routes. Turkish families living en Germany sont généralement members de un caisse funéraire; en that case le fund's partenaire entreprise de pompes funèbres en Germany carries out le transfer as far as Turkey. We take over collection en Istanbul, transfer vers le ville d'inhumation et le municipal procedures. We also repatriate residents de Germany qui décèdent en Turquie.
process: From Germany vers Turkey: we exchange vol et document details avec le entreprise de pompes funèbres ou fund en Germany; we receive le défunt à Istanbul Aéroport, transfer them vers le city et coordinate le inhumation.

From Turkey vers Germany: le certificat de décès, le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C), le soins funéraires certificate et le permis de transport funéraire sont issued; un remise plan est convenu avec le entreprise de pompes funèbres en Germany et le défunt est envoyé par fret aérien.
documents: Pour un défunt arrivant depuis Germany: le German certificat de décès (Sterbeurkunde) et le Turkish consulat's transfer document
Pour un défunt quittant Turkey: Formule C, soins funéraires certificate, permis de transport funéraire et un lettre d'acceptation depuis le entreprise de pompes funèbres en Germany
notes: If there est un caisse funéraire membership en Germany, call le fund first; its partenaire entreprise de pompes funèbres starts le transfer. Nous prenons en charge le transfert national et inhumation that fall hors couverture.
Nous travaillons together avec Turkish entreprises de pompes funèbres en Germany; we act as le interlocuteur unique pour aéroport remise et inhumation.

united-kingdom.name: Royaume-Uni
united-kingdom.title: Royaume-Uni - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
united-kingdom.description: Rapatriement des British ressortissants décédés en Turquie, et transfert funéraire depuis le United Kingdom vers Turkey: assurance, consulat, documents.
united-kingdom.intro: Nous rapatrions British nationals qui décèdent en Turquie sur holiday ou pendant traitement médical, et bring relatives qui décèdent en le United Kingdom vers Turkey. Travel assurance often covers le coût de repatriation; we correspond directly avec le assureur et assistance company.
process: From Turkey vers le United Kingdom: le certificat de décès et le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C) sont issued, soins funéraires est performed, un cercueil scellé est préparé, le necessary correspondence avec le British consulat est completed et le défunt est envoyé par fret aérien.
From le United Kingdom vers Turkey: documents et le vol plan sont convenu avec le entreprise de pompes funèbres there; we receive le défunt en Istanbul et coordinate le transfer et inhumation.
documents: Certificat de décès issued en Turkey, avec English translation
Formule C, soins funéraires certificate, cercueil scellé report, permis de transport funéraire
Approval depuis le assureur ou assistance company (le cas échéant)
notes: A entreprise de pompes funèbres en le United Kingdom doit être appointed vers receive le défunt; si vous le souhaitez, we identify one together avec your assureur.
Le British Embassy publishes guidance sur what vers do après un death en Turkey; we follow that guidance.

russia.name: Russie
russia.title: Russie - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
russia.description: Rapatriement des Russian ressortissants décédés en Turquie: 'gruz 200', consulat, documents, compagnie aérienne.
russia.intro: Russia est Turkey's plus importants source de visitors, et there est un important Russian-speaking communauté vivant en Turquie. For le repatriation de Russian nationals qui décèdent en Turquie (known en russe as 'gruz 200'), we handle le consulaire, soins funéraires, coffin et compagnie aérienne procedures. Nous pouvons correspond en russe.
process: Le certificat de décès et le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C) sont issued; le transfer documents sont obtenus depuis le Consulate General de Russia.
Embalming est performed, un cercueil scellé est préparé et le fret aérien booking est made.
Details sont transmis avec le entreprise de pompes funèbres ou relative who will receive le défunt à le destination aéroport en Russia.
documents: Passeport du défunt
Certificat de décès et Formule C
Certificat de soins funéraires, certificat de cercueil scellé, permis de transport funéraire
Document consulaire de transfert
notes: A entreprise de pompes funèbres en le ville de destination may be needed pour collection en Russia; we put you en touch avec le firms we work avec.
Flight options vary par city; sur connecting vols le cold chain et document continuity sont followed up.

iran.name: Iran
iran.title: Iran - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
iran.description: Rapatriement des Iranian ressortissants décédés en Turquie, et transfert funéraire depuis Iran vers Turkey: consulat, documents, road et air options.
iran.intro: Iran est l'un des le countries sending le les plus visitors vers Turkey, et there est un important Iranian communauté en Istanbul. For le repatriation de Iranian nationals qui décèdent en Turquie vers Tehran et other cities, we handle le consulaire, soins funéraires, coffin et compagnie aérienne procedures. Transfer par road est assessed case par case.
process: Le certificat de décès et le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C) sont issued; le transfer documents sont obtenus depuis le Consulate General de Iran.
Ritual washing et shrouding sont effectués according vers le family's denomination; soins funéraires est performed et un cercueil scellé est préparé.
Le défunt est envoyé par fret aérien vers Tehran ou le relevant city; le proche qui recevra le défunt ou entreprise de pompes funèbres est informé.
documents: Passeport du défunt
Certificat de décès et Formule C
Certificat de soins funéraires, certificat de cercueil scellé, permis de transport funéraire
Document consulaire de transfert
notes: Our Persian page est en preparation; en le meantime we can communicate en anglais ou en turc.
Where transfer par road est possible, we compare le two options en terms de time et coût.

iraq.name: Irak
iraq.title: Irak - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
iraq.description: Rapatriement des Iraqi ressortissants décédés en Turquie pendant treatment ou un visit, à Baghdad, Erbil et other cities: consulat, documents, compagnie aérienne.
iraq.intro: Il existe considerable déplacements depuis Iraq vers Turkey pour traitement médical et visits. For le repatriation de Iraqi nationals qui décèdent en Turquie vers Baghdad, Erbil, Basra et other cities, we handle le hôpital, consulaire et compagnie aérienne procedures depuis un interlocuteur unique. La communication écrite est possible via our Arabic page.
process: Le certificat de décès est obtenu depuis le hôpital et le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C) est issued; le Iraqi consulat's transfer documents sont followed up.
Ritual washing, shrouding et soins funéraires sont effectués; un cercueil scellé est préparé.
Le fret aérien booking est made; details sont transmis avec le relative ou entreprise de pompes funèbres who will receive le défunt à le destination aéroport.
documents: Passeport du défunt
Certificat de décès et Formule C
Certificat de soins funéraires, certificat de cercueil scellé, permis de transport funéraire
Document consulaire de transfert
notes: For patients who came pour traitement médical, we work directly avec le hôpital et le intermediary agency.
Cargo disponibilité sur vols vers Erbil et Baghdad peuvent varier; we work out le les plus suitable option together.

Document consulaire de transfert

saudi-arabia.name: Arabie saoudite
saudi-arabia.title: Arabie saoudite - Rapatriement funéraire Turquie
saudi-arabia.description: Repatriation vers Turkey de relatives qui décèdent en Saudi Arabia, et funeral repatriation depuis Turkey vers Jeddah et Riyadh: consulat, documents, compagnie aérienne.
saudi-arabia.intro: Il existe considerable déplacements between Saudi Arabia et Turkey pour Hajj, Umrah, work et visits. Those who die pendant Hajj ou Umrah sont généralement inhumé there; when le family asks pour repatriation vers Turkey, le processus est effectué avec le Saudi authorities et le Turkish consulat. We cover bringing Turkish citizens who work ou live en Saudi Arabia back vers Turkey, et repatriating Saudi nationals qui décèdent en Turquie vers Jeddah, Riyadh et other cities.
process: From Saudi Arabia vers Turkey: le documents et vol plan sont arranged avec le entreprise de pompes funèbres, employeur ou relative there; le Turkish consulat's transfer document est obtenu. Nous recevons le défunt en Istanbul, transfer them vers le city et coordinate le inhumation.

From Turkey vers Saudi Arabia: le certificat de décès et le multilingual certificat de décès extract (Formule C) sont issued; le Saudi consulat's transfer documents sont obtenus. Ritual washing, shrouding et soins funéraires sont effectués, un cercueil scellé est préparé et le défunt est envoyé par fret aérien vers Jeddah ou Riyadh.

Certificat de décès et Formule C
Certificat de soins funéraires, certificat de cercueil scellé, permis de transport funéraire
Document consulaire de transfert
notes: If repatriation vers Turkey est requested pour someone who dies pendant Hajj ou Umrah, contact est made avec le group leader et le Turkish consulat; what est possible depends sur le decision de le local authorities.
Il y un direct vols depuis Istanbul vers Jeddah et Riyadh; pour other cities le vol options vary par city.

syria.description: Rapatriement funéraire vers Syria: repatriation de Syrians qui décèdent en Turquie, transfert routier et poste-frontière procedures, documents, communication en arabe.
syria.intro: Il existe un important Syrian communauté vivant à Istanbul et across Turkey. Ritual washing, shrouding et soins funéraires sont effectués; un cercueil scellé est préparé et le permis de transport funéraire est obtenu.

Le transfert routier vers le poste-frontière est planifié; details sont transmis avec le relative ou entreprise de pompes funèbres who will receive le défunt sur le other side. An air option est considered case par case.

Document consulaire de transfert (where nécessaire)

france.intro: Nous ramenons home et bury le défunt pour Turkish families living en France, et repatriate residents de France qui décèdent en Turquie. notes: If there est un caisse funéraire membership en France, call le fund first; its partenaire entreprise de pompes funèbres starts le transfer. Nous prenons en charge le transfert national et inhumation that fall hors couverture.

kvkk.title: KVKK Privacy Notice
kvkk.description: Privacy notice under KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.text: Under KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698), your personal data is processed by Doğu Batı Uluslararası Cenaze Hizmetleri (the "Company") as data controller, within the scope described below. The Company's legal name, address and contact details are given on the Imprint page.

sections.title: Personal data processed
sections.text: The full name, phone number, email address, message content and details of your request (place of death, destination) that you send us via the contact form, by phone or on WhatsApp. In the course of the repatriation service, the details of the deceased and their relatives contained in ID cards, passports and official documents; any health information in these documents is special category personal data under KVKK and is processed only to the extent required by law.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
sections.text: Your personal data is processed in order to respond to your request, to plan and carry out the repatriation service, to complete procedures with the authorities, consulates, airlines and customs, to meet legal obligations and to communicate with you. The legal bases under Article 5(2) of KVKK are the conclusion or performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation and legitimate interest; special category data is processed under the conditions set out in Article 6 of KVKK. The consent you give in the contact form is obtained so that we can contact you.

sections.title: Transfers
sections.text: To the extent the service requires, your data may be shared with civil registry offices, municipalities, prosecutors' offices, consulates, airlines and cargo companies, the customs administration and funeral directors in the destination country. Some of these transfers are transfers abroad and are made in accordance with the conditions in Article 9 of KVKK. The service providers used for the website's hosting and email infrastructure are listed on the Imprint page.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.text: Your personal data is kept for as long as the purpose of processing requires and for the limitation periods set by the relevant legislation; at the end of that period it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Under Article 11 of KVKK you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed; to request information if it has been; to learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used for that purpose; to know the third parties to whom it has been transferred; to request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate; to request deletion or destruction; to request that these actions be notified to the third parties to whom the data has been transferred; to object to an outcome against you resulting from analysis by automated systems; and to claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing. You can send your requests to the address or email on the Imprint page; requests are answered within 30 days at the latest.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: dogubaticenaze.com cookie policy: which cookies are used and how to manage them.

sections.title: What is a cookie?
sections.text: Cookies are small text files that the website you visit stores in your browser.

sections.title: Cookies we use
sections.text: Necessary cookies: used to remember your language and to store your cookie preference; the site does not work properly without them. Analytics cookies: used only with your consent, to measure anonymously which pages are visited. We do not use marketing or retargeting cookies.

sections.title: Managing your preferences
sections.text: You can change your preferences in the cookie notice at the bottom of the page, and delete or block cookies in your browser settings. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

sections.title: General
sections.text: The information you share when you visit this website and contact us is used only to respond to your request and to provide the service. Details are given in the KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698) Privacy Notice.

sections.title: Third-party links
sections.text: The site contains links to third-party services such as WhatsApp and maps. When you click these links, the privacy rules of the relevant service apply.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: The site is served over HTTPS. Contact form data is validated on the server and forwarded only to an email account accessible to authorised staff.
